title: Additional Cast for 'Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced the additional cast on Thursday. The anime premiered on October 3 at 6.25 p.m. on NHK E-Tele.

Cast Justice: Natsuki Hanae ( Oni no Hanayome ) Zoe: Mitsuki Saiga ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier ) Colette: Miyuri Shimabukuro ( Yomi no Tsugai )

• Kiyoko Sayama ( Fumetsu no Anata e Season 2 ) is directing the anime at J.C.Staff , with Shinzou Fujita ( Dekin no Mogura ) handling the series composition and script. Yuriko Maeda ( WIXOSS Diva(A)Live sub character design) is designing the characters. Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( Apocalypse Hotel ) is composing the music.

Iwamoto began drawing the historical comedy manga in monthly Flowers magazine in September 2016. Shogakukan published the 11th volume on June 10.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English on October 2.

title: 'Kyoufu Collector' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Midori Satou 's Kyoufu Collector ( Horror Collector ) novel announced three additional cast members on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 10 at 11:45 p.m. on NHK-G.

Cast Momo: Sae Hiratsuka ( Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai ) Raita: Ryouta Oosaka ( Hataraku Maou-sama! ) Sachiko Konno: Hana Hishikawa ( Sayonara Lara )

Yuki Inaba ( Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou ) is directing the anime and composing the series at Studio Palette . Kaori Yoshikawa ( Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen Season II ) is designing the characters. Masato Kouda ( Tsuihousha Shokudou e Youkoso! ) is composing the music.

Japanese director Norio Tsuruta and screenwriter Satou began publishing the horror novels for kids under Kadokawa's Tsubasa Bunko label in June 2015. The 28th volume was released on May 13.

Niko Yuuki drew a manga adaptation in Comic Gene from September 2021 to February 2022. Kadokawa published the manga in a single volume in March 2022.

Yen Press licensed the novel and manga adaptation in English and released the manga volume and the sixth novel volume in May 2025.

title: Bless TV Anime Casts Yoshiki Nakajima
content:
The official website for the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga revealed in a character promotional video on Thursday that Yoshiki Nakajima will voice Joe Osaki in the series.

The anime will star:

• Tomohiro Ōno as Aia Udagawa

• Chiyuki Miura as Jun Sumisaki

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Ginga Yoyogi

• Yoshino Aoyama as Oroka Sumeragi

• Momoka Terasawa as Shitataka Sumeragi

• Kentarō Kumagai as MM

Shōtarō Kitamura ( Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , and Takayuki Kikuchi (episode director for Solo Leveling , Kaguya-sama: Love is War ) is the assistant director. Fukurou Kamiza ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Honoka Yokoyama ( Oshi no Ko TV 2 , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is both the character designer and chief animation director, and Tetsuya Kawakami ( A Certain Magical Index , Sword Art Online ) and Reina Iwasaki ( VTuber Legend: How I Went Viral after Forgetting to Turn Off My Stream ) are also chief animation directors. Ryō Yoshimata ( Somali and the Forest Spirit , After the Rain ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Costume Design: Akane Takeda (A-1 Pictures)

• Prop Design: Takayuki Kidou

• Main Animators: Yūichirō Iida, Marina Kobayashi, Mirai Harashima (A-1 Pictures)

• Hair and Makeup Supervisor: Katsuyoshi Kojima (tron)

• Graphic Illustration: Kashimaki

• Color Design: Mana Hokuto (A-1 Pictures)

• Art Director: Risa Wakabayashi (A-1 Pictures)

• Background Art: Kiya Hirayoshi (A-1 Pictures)

• CG Director: Yuki Kuribayashi

• Director of Photography: Hideki Eto (EXPLOSION)

• Editing: Kiyoshi Hirose

• Sound Director: Kōhei Yoshida

• Sound Effects: Takuya Hasegawa

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonoyama debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha published the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

The manga is also inspiring a live-action series that Amazon Prime Video will stream worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.

title: 'Hone Dragon no Mana Musume' Reveals Main Cast, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ichi Yukishiro 's Hone Dragon no Mana Musume ( The Skull Dragon's Precious Daughter ) web manga revealed the main cast, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Thursday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Kana Hanazawa ( Angel Beats! ) and Kazuhiko Inoue ( Natsume Yuujinchou ) are starring as Eve and Nemu, respectively.

Kuniyasu Nishina ( Isekai Ojisan episode director) is helming the anime at Doga Kobo , with Yuka Yamada ( Hoshifuru Oukoku no Nina ) handling the series composition. Tomoya Atsumi ( Tokidoki Bosotto Russia-go de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san animation director) is designing the characters. Daiki Kuribayashi ( Shoukoku no Altair ) and Yuuki Hatakeyama ( Summertime Render ) are in charge of background art.

Yukishiro originally began serializing the slice of life fantasy series on the MAGCOMI web service in September 2020, it was later being transferred to Comic Garden in January 2022. Mag Garden published the sixth volume in August 2025.

J-Novel Club licensed the series in English digitally in May 2022. Media Do licensed the series in print in October 2022. The sixth digital volume went on sale on April 29, with the physical edition scheduled for a December 1 release.

Hone Dragon no Mana Musume was nominated in the web category at the 2021 Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Awards .

title: The Vermilion Mask Anime's 2nd Part Debuts in April 2027
content:
The official website for the anime of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's The Vermillion Mask ( Shuiro no Kamen ) manga announced on Thursday that the anime's second part will debut in April 2027 on the Yomiuri TV and NTV channels, and will air every Saturday at 5:30 p.m. JST.

Yomiuri TV describes the anime:

At the center of the story is Peru, a young apprentice mask maker who loses control under the influence of a cursed mask, slaying both his master and comrades in a tragic outburst. Wracked with guilt, Peru sets off on a journey to destroy the legendary masks his master once crafted, crossing paths with unlikely allies and deadly foes. What unfolds is a gripping battle for redemption, as both the fate of Peru's soul and the world itself hang in the balance.

The anime will premiere on October 10 on Yomiuri TV and NTV at 5:30 p.m. JST, and it will have two parts or cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs.

The anime stars:

• Taihi Kimura as Peru d'Arrest

• Yūki Yamamoto as Sonarue Maywood

• Kazuki Ura as Mok Sharib

• Takanori Hoshino as Gouon

• Wataru Komada as Totoque

• Junya Enoki as Zent

• Kazuhiko Inoue as Gaston

• Akio Ōtsuka as Mask of the Warrior God

• Kenji Nojima as Hien

• Aoi Koga as Lasgarl

• Yūki Shin as Clown

• Akihisa Wakayama as Rinne

• Aya Endō as The Mask of Necromancy

• Yui Horie as Master

T.N.T rock band's vocalist Yuya Tegoshi will also voice a character in the anime's 12th episode. (That episode will be the final episode of the anime's first part.)

Tetsuaki Watanabe ( BLUELOCK season 1) is directing the anime at 100Studio (WOW Studio). Gai Hazako is the assistant director. Daisuke Ōhigashi ( Fate/strange Fake ) is in charge of series composition. Hisashi Higashijima ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles ) is drawing the character designs. Fumiyuki Go is the sound director. Arisa Okehazama ( The Apothecary Diaries ) is composing the music.

MAN WITH A MISSION performs the opening theme song "Firestarter," and yutori performs the ending theme song "Koe."

Dr.Poro and Naba launched the manga in Shōnengahōsha 's Young King Ours magazine in February 2021. Shōnengahōsha will publish the manga's 10th compiled book volume on November 30.

Orange's emaqi e-bookstore platform publishes the manga in English.

title: Leeds Film Festival Will Screen Live-Action Look Back and Animated Grotesqqque in November
content:
Tickets for the festival will go on sale on Thursday October 8 at 9 p.m.

The three Look Back screenings will be on Sunday November 8 at the Cottage Road Cinema at 12 noon; on Friday November 13 at Vue in the Light at 8.45 p.m.; and on Sunday November 15 at 4.45 p.m. The latter screening include descriptive subtitles. (The festival is also screening a different live-action film, Sheep in the Box by the same director, Hirokazu Kore-eda ,

The London Film Festival, which is also screening the film, describes it at follows:

Spanning more than a decade, Hirokazu Kore-eda 's tender coming-of-age story follows two girls who bond over their passion for and dream of becoming manga artists. Fujino, a gifted artist and aspiring manga artist, meets Kymoto, a shy admirer of her work. Seemingly opposites, they create the perfect team with their shared love of the form. But as their work draws praise and attention, they find themselves confronted with decisions that threaten their artistic collaboration. Koreeda's beautiful love letter to friendship and the creative process offers keen insight into the craft.

Hirokazu Kore-eda ( Shoplifters , Our Little Sister , Air Doll ) directed and edited the film, and also wrote the screenplay. Yūta Bandō ( BELLE , Kaiju No. 8 , also known as Taku Matsushiba ) composed the music.

The live-action Look Back film opened on September 11 in Japan.

The film is described on the festival website as follows:

"A hit at this year's Fantasia film festival, Grotesqqque is a music-fuelled, girl-filled anime anthology film in three parts from CloverWorks studio and Atsushi Nishigori , Chief Animation Director behind Evangelion: 3.0+1.0: Thrice Upon A Time .

"A(E)lien is a slapstick comedy starring a full-throttle alien Octopus Girl . In Yoroshiku★Girl, a frenzied battle royale is fought among gyarus (‘gals’). In Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque, a pureblood vampire and three ‘infected’ girls are sole post-apocalyptic survivors."

The episodes of the film are by Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) and Takahiro Miura .

The band METALVERSE performed the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performed the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film came from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .
author: ANN

title: London International Animation Festival Will Screen Jinsei on November 29
content:
The London International Animation Festival will include the UK premiere screening of Jinsei ( Mumei no Jinsei ), the first feature anime film from the independent anime director Ryūya Suzuki .

The screening will be on Sunday November 29 at 1.30 p.m. at the Garden Cinema, near Covent Garden. The film's website page is here and tickets will go on sale on October 15. The film is described at the festival website as follows:

"What if one life could contain a hundred different lives? Ryūya Suzuki 's Jinsei follows an unnamed man from bullied schoolboy to aspiring J-pop idol, outcast, leader and oracle, with each new chapter bringing a new name – and a whole new reality. What begins as an intimate coming-of-age story soon hurtles into something much stranger: social satire, revenge drama, dystopian sci-fi and existential fever dream.

"And then there's the animation. Suzuki wrote, directed, drew, edited and scored the entire 93-minute film himself, completing this wildly ambitious debut in just 18 months. The result is raw, lo-fi and gloriously unpredictable – a handmade universe that can veer from tenderness to violence, pop culture absurdity to cosmic speculation without warning."

Ryūya Suzuki is credited with the original work and as the director, animation director, art director, compositing director of photography, color key artist, character designer, editor, and composer. Kenji Iwaisawa ( ON-GAKU: Our Sound , Hina is Beautiful director) is the producer.

The film opened at Tokyo's Shinjuku Musashino-kan theater and other theaters in Japan in May 2025, and also screened at last year's Annecy International Animation Film Festival. The film additionally screened at last year's Tokyo International Film Festival in October.

Suzuki's "Mahoroba" short won awards at independent film festivals in Japan in 2021, and his " Lawless Love " animated short won the Japan Grand Prix award at the New Chitose Airport International Animation Festival in 2022.
author: ANN

title: Double-Bill of Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway Films Will Be Screened at UK Cinemas on Saturday
content:
The following locations are listed on the Odeon website : Bath, Belfast, Birmingham New Street, Bournemouth, Braehead, Brighton, Bristol, Cardiff, Coventry, Greenwich, Guilford, Kingston, Lee Valley, Leicester, Liverpool One, Manchester Great Northern, Metrocentre (Gateshead), Norwich and Sheffield.

The double-bill will have a combined running time of 203 minutes, Screening attendees will receive what is described as an exclusive Mobile Suit Gundam poster, while stocks last.

The two films are summarised as follows:

MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The year is U.C. 0105, twelve years after Char's Rebellion. The anti-government organization "Mafty," led by someone called "Mafty Navue Erin," has taken a stand against the corrupt leadership of the Earth Federation. As Mafty carries out terror attacks and assassinates government officials, it gains support from the angry populace. Mafty's leader is actually Hathaway Noa, the son of war hero Bright Noa. Inspired by the ideals of Amuro Ray and Char Aznable, Hathaway plans to follow in their footsteps and clear a path forward through armed resistance. His destiny, however, is drastically altered as he encounters the Federation officer Kenneth Sleg and a mysterious young beauty named Gigi Andalucia. Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway is drawn to a mysterious girl named Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for MAFTY's mission — the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Kenneth Sleg of the Earth Federation Forces prepares a defence operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate MAFTY and is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfil her own role.

The film project is a trilogy, and the second part had a working title of Kidō Senshi Gundam: Senkō no Hathaway : San of Bright . The film's producer Ogata elaborated that the Japanese katakana characters "San" (サン) can be read as "sun" or "son." (The film's main character Hathaway Noa is the son of the character Bright Noa.) Ogata stated the second part would have some differences from Yoshiyuki Tomino 's original novel series.
